spans.s: नृ—च॑क्षस् mfn. beholding or watching men (said of gods), RV.; AV.; VS.; TS.
looking after men i.e. leading or guiding them (as a Ṛṣi), RV. iii, 53, 9; 10
नृ—च॑क्षस् m. ‘waiting for men’, a Rākṣasa, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 54,
नृ—चक्षुस् mfn. seeing with human eyes, Hariv.
नृ—चक्षुस् m. N. of a prince (a grandson or son of Su-nītha), Pur.
नृ—चन्द्र m. ‘man-moon’, N. of a prince (a son of Ranti-nāra), Pur.
